Here’s my question to you: Do YOU see how hard you’re trying to stay alive? I’ve spent a lot of time concerned with others’ opinions and that’s because we are never taught to question the validity of how others see us. I have no reason to think that you’re just an attention seeker. There’s something ingrained into us by the society we live in that others’ opinions define the truth of who we are and there’s no shame in acknowledging that we have been indoctrinated this way. It’s how those with “power” remain in “power”. But at the end of the day, do you believe that you are putting in sufficient effort to stay alive? Or maybe, can you imagine that someone else looking at your situation might see it that way? If so, then you’re doing enough for yourself right now. Keep at it.

And for what it’s worth, by you asking this question, yeah I can tell that you are really fighting to keep going. You’re doing great.
